encoding.optionalStruct: u32 presence followed by members if present
encoding.strings: u32 UTF-8 length, bytes, pad4; nullable_string permits 0xffffffff
encoding.arrays: u32 count then element alignment then elements
encoding.structs: chain-count first for extensible; then YAML members in order; each scalar naturally aligned, no implicit struct-tail padding
encoding.chain: u32 count then u32 sType and extension members; no guest pointers
encoding.nullHandle: two zero u32s only where YAML optional
encoding.flags: u64 as WGPUFlags, checked before converting to Number
encoding.nativeSizes: usize is u64 on the wire, independent of guest pointer width
encoding.chunk: header flags 1 more or 2 final; logical length, offset, payload length, reserved zero; exact raw bytes then pad8
encoding.encode: receiver is the command_encoder; nested records omit receiver and retain encoder/pass state across blobs
encoding.deferred: render-bundle and buffer-unmap-writes reserve numbers but have no accepted body in G0.1
